newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Montgomery County, N.Y..

text.p: at Roosevelt & Cross Inc., 20 Exchange Place,
Bonds dated June 15, 1997, interest June 15 and December 15 each year commencing June 15, 1998. Bonds mature in principal installments on June 15 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

2004 250,000 Bids, accompanied by a $97,500 good faith deposit check, must be for all $4,875,000 bonds. Award shall be based on net interest cost. Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of said Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., Cicero Professional Building, 6221 Route 31, Suite 112, Cicero, New York 13039, telephone number: (315) 699-7912; fax: (315) 699-8833.
